parameters.query: SELECT id, project_id, project_type, location_zone, property_type, area_m2, summary, scope_summary, decisions_made, lessons_learned, patterns, tags, cost_estimated, duration_estimated_days, 1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector) as similarity FROM memory_cases WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL AND ($3::uuid IS NULL OR project_id != $3::uuid) ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::vector LIMIT $2::int
